messages:
alex_ops: fyi — eu-west1 fw rollout (BMC 2.7.1) started at ~3581234400 and we started seeing scheduler heartbeats lag out. noticed multiple GPU evictions and provisioning backpressure. dropping capacity from 92% -> ~58% in 10m.

mike_oncall: copy. is this the new scheduler change from the 2.7 branch?

yuan_fw: yes, 2.7.1 includes the new fw scheduler that batches SOL sessions differently. haven't seen evictions in staging. can you paste logs?

alex_ops: here's a short excerpt from the oob controller logs on rack-12:```
Mar 20 12:07:05 oob-proxy[1203]: scheduler: heartbeat delayed by 14.2s for host rack-12-node-07
Mar 20 12:07:06 oob-proxy[1203]: ipmi: session storm 37 conn/s -> dropping keepalive
Mar 20 12:07:08 provisioner[88]: evicting 3 GPUs from rack-12-node-07 (OOM threshold)
```

anita_sre: pinging network team to ensure no mcast storm. last time we saw this it was an mdns flood from provisioning hooks.

opsbot: Deploy Bot: rollout bmc-fw-2.7.1 started by @jul ia_platform at 12:02 UTC. Current stage: canary (10 hosts).

julia_platform: I bumped canary to 20 yesterday night to speed up rollout. reverting to 10 and pausing is fine.

mike_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) revert scheduler toggle on the canary hosts, 3) drain affected hosts & reprovision via older image. can someone run the pause job?

yuan_fw: ETA for a fast revert is ~6-8m per host if we use the rollback hotpath (no full reflash). cmd I'll run:```
for h in $(cat canary-hosts.txt); do ssh ops@$h 'sudo /usr/local/bin/bmc-revert --profile scheduler-toggle-off' & done
```

alex_ops: doing a quick capacity redistribute: moved two queued jobs to eu-central1 to reduce evictions.

anita_sre: network update: no mcast storm, but seeing increased UDP retransmit on OOB vlan (0.6% -> 3.2%) during the timeframe. might be packet bursts causing scheduler timeouts.

julia_platform: paused rollout via console, canary is frozen. opsbot confirmed pause.

opsbot: Deploy Bot: rollout bmc-fw-2.7.1 paused by @julia_platform at 12:16 UTC.

mike_oncall: good. next steps: yuan, revert the scheduler toggle on the 20 canary hosts and backfill them with the 2.6.9 profile if revert fails. alex, keep shifting workloads as needed. anita, please open a ticket with net team and attach pcap of OOB vlan during 12:05-12:18.

yuan_fw: starting revert now, will post progress.

alex_ops: noted. posting runbook link for reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oob-bmc-heartbeat

anita_sre: ticket created: INF-7823, attached pcap. tagging network oncall @net_oncall.

yuan_fw: revert script output (partial):```
[ok] reverted scheduler-toggle on rack-12-node-03
[ok] reverted scheduler-toggle on rack-12-node-04
[fail] revert timeout on rack-12-node-07 -> escalation to hardware team
```

mike_oncall: rack-12-node-07 is the same node showing repeated evictions. hardware team needed for possible UART flakiness. I'll loop them in.

julia_platform: thanks everyone. keep a hand on capacity dashboard. I'll coordinate a slowed rollout once we have a stable revert test. :thumbsup:
